The '''SC-4.x control tether''' was a type of [[control cable]] used in the construction of [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. Produced by [[Moriales Systems]], the SC-4.x were used in certain parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] instead of the [[Perfect-Series control cables]] produced by [[Steelton/Legends|Steelton]].
